title: 第12章 撤回！立刻！马上！
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一夜好眠。

赵楹月掐点下楼。

依旧是那头夸张的彩虹色头发，搭配精神小妹独特的妆容。

让人眼前黑了又黑。

尤其还有孟以棠这个小白花的清纯当对比，更衬得赵楹月不伦不类。

“哥，你昨晚做贼去了？”

赵楹月哪壶不开提哪壶。

在餐桌前坐下后，盯着赵随野那明显的两个黑眼圈，明知故问。

赵随野皮笑肉不笑，“某些人心里没数？”

要不是听管家说赵楹月晚上要去找那死黄毛玩玩具。

他何至于整夜守在大门口没合眼？

现在西装下的皮肤，都是蚊子叮的大包。

赵楹月无辜眨眼，“哥，你别冤枉我，我可没让你去做贼。”

话落，赵随野一口气顿时梗在了喉间。

上不去又下不来。

暗自咬牙，以前他怎么没发现妹妹说话如此牙尖嘴利？

果然是被那死黄毛带坏了！

远在城南网吧当网管的秦渡，再次毫无征兆的打了个喷嚏。

一顿早餐，赵随野勉强塞了一片吐司进肚，气饱了。

等上了车，他才稍微平静下来。

叮嘱赵楹月：“月月，去了公司，你就好好待在你的岗位，不要乱跑。”

“下班我会亲自来接你，如果没看见你人，一次扣一万。”

赵楹月低头玩着手机，敷衍的‘嗯嗯’两声。

孟以棠适时开口：“随野，你就放心吧，我会带着月月熟悉岗位。”

不得不说，赵随野是真的很贴心。

给她安排的活都很轻松。

不用写策划、不用写周报，更不用和难缠的甲方周旋。

只需要每天按时上下班打卡，就简简单单月入三万。

这不比她之前在外面打的零工好？

累死累活十几个小时，收入才三百不到。

连母亲一天的医药费都凑不齐。

“以棠，那就麻烦你了。”

孟以棠温和笑笑，“没事，都是我应该做的。”

赵楹月听得起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。

不禁再次感慨起，还好家里就只有一个舔狗。

如果弟弟也跟赵随野一样是女主的舔狗，那赵楹月觉得，她都不用挣扎了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Have a good night's sleep.

Zhao Yingyue nodded and went downstairs.

She still has that exaggerated rainbow-colored hair, paired with the spirited girl’s unique makeup.

It makes people's eyes dark and dark.

Especially when contrasted with the innocence of this little white flower, Meng Yitang, it makes Zhao Yingyue even more nondescript.

"Brother, did you commit thief last night?"

Which pot does Zhao Yingyue not open and pick up?

After sitting down at the dining table, he stared at Zhao Suiye's two obvious dark circles and asked questions knowingly.

Zhao Suiye smiled softly, "Some people don't know?"

If it hadn't been for the housekeeper saying that Zhao Yingyue was going to find that damn Huang Mao to play with toys at night.

Why did he stay at the gate all night without sleeping?

Now the skin under the suit is full of mosquito bites.

Zhao Yingyue blinked innocently, "Brother, don't accuse me wrongly. I didn't ask you to be a thief."

As soon as the words fell, Zhao Suiye's breath suddenly caught in his throat.

Can't go up and can't come down.

Gritting his teeth secretly, why didn't he notice that his sister was so sharp-tongued before?

As expected, he was led astray by that damn yellow hair!

Qin Du, who was working as a network administrator at an Internet cafe in the south of the city, sneezed again without warning.

After breakfast, Zhao Suiye reluctantly stuffed a piece of toast into his stomach and felt full.

After getting into the car, he calmed down a little.

He told Zhao Yingyue: "Yueyue, when you go to the company, you should stay at your post and don't run around."

"I will pick you up personally after get off work. If I don't see you, I will deduct 10,000 yuan at a time."

Zhao Yingyue lowered her head and played with her mobile phone, saying "hmm" perfunctorily.

Meng Yitang spoke at the right time: "Suiya, don't worry, I will take Yueyue to familiarize yourself with the position."

I have to say that Zhao Suiye is really considerate.

The tasks assigned to her were all easy.

There is no need to write a plan, no need to write a weekly report, and no need to deal with the difficult Party A.

As long as you clock in and clock out on time every day, you can easily earn 30,000 yuan a month.

Isn't this better than the odd job she had before?

After working exhaustingly for more than ten hours, my income was less than three hundred.

He couldn't even pay for his mother's medical expenses for a day.

"Yitang, I'm sorry to trouble you."

Meng Yitang smiled gently, "It's okay, it's all what I should do."

Zhao Yingyue felt goosebumps all over after hearing this.

I couldn't help but sigh again, fortunately there is only one licking dog in the house.

If her younger brother was the heroine's licker like Zhao Suiye, then Zhao Yingyue felt that she wouldn't have to struggle.
